products.title: Hurricane - Boule Lamp Rock - Sage
products.description_html:
Hurricane Rock is a combination of industrial design and handicraft. It is inspired by the fantastic rock formation "Lords Rock" in Bohemia. Through a unique process, the colour flows into the crystal clear glass when pressed by hand.

Hurricane Rock is approx. 12 cm in height and 10 cm in diameter. Weight is approx. 1,4 kg. Use a maximum 35 mm diameter paraffin tealight. Make sure the light is centered in the lantern to avoid uneven heating of the inner walls of the lantern.

Hurricane Rock is a hand-pressed lantern. As a result of this artisanal process, small irregularities may appear within the glass—such as tiny bubbles, delicate lines, or subtle folds in the material. These are beautiful hallmarks of the handcrafted nature of the piece, endowing each Hurricane Rock with its own unique character and charm.

The tea ceremony, slow and meditative. Hypnotic gestures of an ancient tradition performed one by one in a symbolic ritual. A balanced and pure blend of bergamot and Japanese green Sencha tea, complemented by a note of guaiacum wood.
A tribute to slowness.

products.description_html:

Tessuto: Walking through a cotton field, hands open, caressing the fluffy bolls. Touching the lightness of fine silk weaves and natural linens on Lake Como; closing your eyes and breathing in their cool, reassuring texture. Feeling at home, always.

Tessuto:

The coolness of linen and the rustle of silk.

products.title: Diffuser Stile Supreme Amber
products.description_html:

Supreme Amber: a soft sunset at the end of September in the middle of a park, when the summer slowly fades into autumn. The warm atmosphere made sparkling by a fresh breeze.

Supreme Amber:

Supreme Amber tells the atmosphere of a soft sunset in the end of September: imagine a walk in a park lit by warm colors, the air sparkling announcing the arrival of a new season. Supreme Amber is the invitation to live a passing moment in all its complex essence; to enter into an unexpected change with determination and sweet abandonment.

The warm and intense background of incense and patchouli is softened by the precious black vanilla and made fresh by the lively opening of cyst and chinotto: a complex and deeply rich fragrance, perfect to tell the thousand facets of a magic moment.

products.title: Hurricane - Lamp Soda - Pink
products.description_html:
Hurricane Soda is crafted through using an ancient glassblowing technique of adding sodium carbonate during the manufacturing process. This enables bubbles to appear, like magic, inside the glass. Each piece is entirely unique in its appearance, some with many bubbles and some with few, forming a distinctive pattern in each lamp.

Hurricane Soda Pink is 12 cm high and 10 cm in diameter. Weight is approx. 1,5 kg. We recommend a 35 mm in diameter paraffin tealight.

Please note, all products are individually handcrafted with artisan techniques. Any irregularities and variations found are part of each product’s unique beauty and finish.

All hurricanes should be hand washed separately in warm soapy water, rinsed thoroughly and dried with a lint-free cloth.

products.title: Hurricane - Boule Lamp Rock - Rosé
products.description_html:
Hurricane Rock is a combination of industrial design and handicraft. It is inspired by the fantastic rock formation "Lords Rock" in Bohemia. Through a unique process, the colour flows into the crystal clear glass when pressed by hand.

Hurricane Rock is approx. 12 cm in height and 10 cm in diameter. Weight is approx. 1,4 kg. Use a maximum 35 mm diameter paraffin tealight. Make sure the light is centered in the lantern to avoid uneven heating of the inner walls of the lantern.

Hurricane Rock is a hand-pressed lantern. As a result of this artisanal process, small irregularities may appear within the glass—such as tiny bubbles, delicate lines, or subtle folds in the material. These are beautiful hallmarks of the handcrafted nature of the piece, endowing each Hurricane Rock with its own unique character and charm

products.description_html:
In celebration of Mickey Mouse's 90th birthday, the iconic Disney character has been mounted on Arik Levy's famous Rock sculpture, creating a one-of-a-kind piece. 

"With this creation, the direction I wanted to take goes beyond the simple integration of my artistic ideas on a Disney icon. products.description_html:
By blending Dutch heritage with the globally recognized icon Mickey Mouse and the exceptional craftsmanship of the Leblon Delienne workshop, Marcel Wanders subtly intertwines universes and eras to create a timeless masterpiece.

Known for his quirky and extravagant style, Wanders brings a very personal signature by reinterpreting Delft blue in a contemporary, even abstract context that defines his work, painting the resin sculpture of Mickey by hand.

For the finishing touch, he imaginatively—and with a touch of humor—applies a chrome gold finish to Mickey's nose. The piece is handcrafted in the historic Leblon Delienne workshop in Normandy, France, and hand-painted by the artist.

products.title: One Minute - Mickey - Large
products.description_html:
By blending Dutch heritage with the globally recognized icon Mickey Mouse and the exceptional craftsmanship of the Leblon Delienne workshop, Marcel Wanders subtly intertwines universes and eras to create a timeless masterpiece.

Known for his quirky and extravagant style, Wanders brings a very personal signature by reinterpreting Delft blue in a contemporary, even abstract context that defines his work, painting the resin sculpture of Mickey by hand.

For the finishing touch, he imaginatively—and with a touch of humor—applies a chrome gold finish to Mickey's nose. The piece is handcrafted in the historic Leblon Delienne workshop in Normandy, France, and hand-painted by the artist.

products.title: Accessories - Ueno - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
The Ueno screen, in line with the Timeout collection, is characterised by its burnished metal frame and hand-woven polypropylene cord in the colour anthracite. A decorative element that helps modulate the space, adding a discreet touch of style to every outdoor environment.

Thanks to its interplay of material and structural references, it can be used both with the elements of the Timeout Collection and with the entire Outdoor Collection. In addition to the screen, the range includes a large array of products, such as the sofa, the dining table with seats, the comfortable lounger, side tables, stools and bench.

products.title: Accessories - Boulogne - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
Practical, lightweight and easily movable baskets for towels or magazines are designed to create order and embellish outdoor spaces.

They take up the weave theme common to the two outdoor collections, here expressed in the simple warp and weft motif, made of strips of the same size as Hyde pouffe. For reasons of resistance, the baskets are made entirely of olive-green EVA polyurethane.

The baskets are available in three sizes and in a rectangular shape so that they can be stacked when empty to minimise clutter. The first product in a range of accessories that will grow in the future, the baskets show the search, underlying Molteni&C's outdoor collections, for all-round comfort that invites relaxation and conviviality, where every element has its place.

products.title: Ottoman - Bongo - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: The Bongo ottoman designed by Paola Navone, with its ethnic and minimalist design, becomes the elegant centrepiece of the living space. The ottoman’s iconic shape – reminiscent of the sculptural forms of African drums – is an ironic invitation to sit and enjoy social moments. The formal aspect is carefully designed down to the smallest detail by the exquisite workmanship of the raw-edge leather stitching, which outlines sinuous and enveloping shapes and gives the seat a unique and original appearance.

products.title: Spray Thé
products.description_html:
Exclusive sculpted, square-shaped bottle in clear glass with different coloured serigraphy for each fragrance. The: Soaking in the meditative warmth of a bath tub filled with Japanese green tea. Vapours rise hypnotically off the water, delicately diffusing and filling the room with the aroma of tea leaves.

Thé:

The tea ceremony, slow and meditative. Hypnotic gestures of an ancient tradition performed one by one in a symbolic ritual. A balanced and pure blend of bergamot and Japanese green Sencha tea, complemented by a note of guaiacum wood.
A tribute to slowness.

Room Spray, Bergamot, Sencha Tea, Guaiacum Wood

products.title: Spray Tessuto
products.description_html:
Exclusive sculpted, square-shaped bottle in clear glass with different coloured serigraphy for each fragrance. Tessuto: Walking through a cotton field, hands open, caressing the fluffy bolls. Touching the lightness of fine silk weaves and natural linens on Lake Como; closing your eyes and breathing in their cool, reassuring texture. Feeling at home, always.

Tessuto:

The coolness of linen and the rustle of silk.
A unique fragrance, created in Como as a tribute to the most precious and natural fibres. Its pervading fragrance is ‘woven’ from bergamot, cassis flowers and cotton leaves, leading to a heart of jasmine and closing with a clean background of white musk.

Room Spray, Cassis Leaves, Cotton Flowers, Jasmine, White Musk

products.title: Spray Supreme Amber
products.description_html:
Exclusive sculpted, square-shaped bottle in clear glass with different coloured serigraphy for each fragrance. Supreme Amber: a soft sunset at the end of September in the middle of a park, when the summer slowly fades into autumn. The warm atmosphere made sparkling by a fresh breeze.

Quercea:

Supreme Amber tells the atmosphere of a soft sunset in the end of September: imagine a walk in a park lit by warm colors, the air sparkling announcing the arrival of a new season. Supreme Amber is the invitation to live a passing moment in all its complex essence; to enter into an unexpected change with determination and sweet abandonment.

The warm and intense background of incense and patchouli is softened by the precious black vanilla and made fresh by the lively opening of cyst and chinotto: a complex and deeply rich fragrance, perfect to tell the thousand facets of a magic moment.

Room Spray, Incense, Chinot,To Black Vanilla,  Patchouli

Baccarat unveils a collection of its iconic decanters crowned with a red crystal stopper, the Maison's signature color. Since 1841, the collection has graced the most prestigious tables, transforming every moment into a refined celebration. Sculpted from the purest crystal, the Harcourt Whisky decanter captures the light in a captivating way, revealing a play of reflections that embellishes each liqueur. An essential for discerning connoisseurs, the Harcourt whisky decanter elevates every tasting into a unique sensory experience.

products.title: Mickey Kamo - Medium
products.description_html:
Height: 60cm

A fan of pop culture and heroic comics, Jean-Charles de Castelbajac began incorporating iconic characters like Mickey Mouse into his knit sweaters in the late 1970s, worn by the hip-hop scene and now legendary.

"I’ve reimagined Mickey so many times in my life through my fashion and art. His unique and timeless silhouette has always inspired me. Today, with Leblon Delienne, I’ve finally been able to crystallize him in sculpture, with camouflage and color block, two foundational codes of my style."

Jean-Charles de Castelbajac

Mickey Kamo stands out with its vibrant colors and primary hues, blending the playful spirit of Mickey Mouse with the avant-garde aesthetic of the Artist.

products.title: Tray - Mad - Small - Rose Crystal
products.description_html:
Everyday objects that captivate and exist to add naughty playfulness to your everyday life. Embrace a touch of madness and infuse your space with a whole new dimension of excitement. The Mad Tray works its magic, giving a bold twist to anything placed upon it. Expertly crafted by our artisans, its seemingly simple structure hides seductive details: clean cuts, interlocking blocks, and a bewitching fusion of two alluring colours. Available in two sizes, feel free to mix and match, for an extraordinary experience that breaks the boundaries of the mundane.

Crystal and Onyx United: Onyx is a striking natural stone valued for its unique color patterns and translucency. It belongs to the quartz family and is formed in sedimentary rock layers. The Onyx bears a tapestry of visible holes, marks, and imperfections, while the Crystal is remarkably clear and perfect. The unique charm of onyx lies in its imperfections, which are not flaws but rather authentic signatures, each stone boasting its own distinct variations. Employing transparent crystal can accentuate the visual and tactile allure of onyx, emphasizing the distinctiveness of the two materials.

products.title: Watch Winder - Earth Double - Midnight Blue
products.description_html:
The Earth Double Watch Winder, from the 190th anniversary collection, brings together innovative design, elegance and sustainability. Featuring an apple leather exterior with toning matt metallic hardware and bezels combined with a recycled jacquard silk interior with the WOLF signature pattern. The Dynamic Lock-in Cuff is customisable to three different wrist sizes and locks your watch inside the winder. Choose the required Turns per Day and direction for your watches via the WOLF Bluetooth app. In the top storage section find three suspended watch cushions and removable accessory tray with multiple sections for your valuables.

Dimensions 
33.7cm L x 20.3cm W x 22.9cm H
Features

  • Individually controlled single Bluetooth watch winder with patented innovation: Every WOLF winder counts the precise number of rotations. All other winders estimate the number of rotations 
  • Lock-in dynamic cuff: Patented lock-in dynamic cuff ‘locks’ your timepiece into the rotator drum for a secure fit. Low density foam to accommodate all wrist sizes without putting pressure on your bracelet 
  • Rotation options: Customisable pre-programmed rotation 1–1,999 turns per day (TPD) 
  • Directional settings: Clockwise, counter clockwise and bi-directional 
  • Power reserve setting: 6 to 72 hours in increments of 6 hours power reserve setting to accommodate watches with a power reserve, giving the watch time to release stored energy before the winding program begins 
  • Start delay: Fully wound watches or those that have a power reserve, select from 1–255 hours, selected program will not start until start delay hours elapse 
  • Watch protection and winding: Keeps 2 watches safe and wound, ready to wear. Use the WOLF app to set Turns Per Day and direction of rotation 
  • Patented watch winders: WOLF winders count turns per day no other winder does this, others use time to estimate rotations
  • AC power (universal adapter included)
  • Storage for 3 watches on suspended watch cushions and removable accessory tray in top section
  • Presented in 190th anniversary limited edition packaging
  • Material: Apple leather exterior and recycled jacquard satin interior with WOLF signature pattern, matt metallic hardware

products.description_html:

Hurricane Crystal Strict Extra Large is 36 cm in height and 23 cm in diameter and weighs a sumptuous 10 kg. We recommend a 10-12 cm in diameter good quality paraffin candle.

Please note, all products are individually handcrafted with artisan techniques. Any irregularities and variations found are part of each product’s unique beauty and finish.

All Hurricanes should be hand washed separately in warm soapy water, rinsed thoroughly and dried with a lint-free cloth.

products.title: Hurricane - Boule Lamp Rock - Plum
products.description_html:
Hurricane Rock is a combination of industrial design and handicraft. It is inspired by the fantastic rock formation "Lords Rock" in Bohemia. Through a unique process, the colour flows into the crystal clear glass when pressed by hand.

Hurricane Rock is approx. 12 cm in height and 10 cm in diameter. Weight is approx. 1.4 kg. We recommend a maximum 35 mm diameter paraffin tea light - preferably in a plastic cup, which gives a more beautiful light. Make sure the light is centered in the lantern to avoid uneven heating of the inner walls of the lantern.

Please note, Hurricane Rock is a hand-pressed lantern, which means that each lantern is created by hand. This means that small irregularities inside the glass can occur in the process, such as small bubbles and lines. These are nothing more than part of the handmade work and give each Hurricane Rock its own unique character and beauty.

Made to protect your most precious valuables in style. The Mahogany Churchill is a truly one of a kind piece lined in black suede and adorned with silver hardware accents. A luxurious safe wrapped in black pebble leather and incased in a striking mahogany wood cabinet in a satin finish.

  • i-Mode feature controls LED light with the ability to set on/off timers based on your schedule
  • Password-protected app control
  • Register your warranty from your phone
  • Contact customer service and shop online

products.title: Watch Winder - Module 4.1 - Black
products.description_html:
The ultimate, the one, the only. 4.1 is the solution to the dilemma, “how many winders?” You own one watch no problem, you have three, we can take care of that. Once you buy another watch, buy another 4.1 winder. They connect and are powered together. Build your own watch winder tower, be creative!

Dimensions
12.2cm L x 16.7cm W x 16cm H

Features
  • Patented Innovation - Every WOLF winder counts the precise number of rotations. All other winders estimate the number of rotations.
  • Lock-in dynamic cuff: Patented lock-in dynamic cuff ‘locks’ your timepiece into the rotator drum for a secure fit. Low density foam to accommodate all wrist sizes without putting pressure on your bracelet.
  • Rotation: 10 second start delay, 900 TPD (Turns Per Day), patented rotation programs - Intermittent rotation with pause and sleep phases pre-programmed.
  • Directional Settings: C lockwise, counter clockwise and bi-directional
  • Power reserve setting: 6 to 72 hours in increments of 6 hours power reserve setting to accommodate watches with a power reserve, giving the watch time to release stored energy before the winding program begins.
  • Power Options: AC power (universal adapter included. One adapter can power up to 12 modules).
  • Other: 1 bridal cable, 1 connector joint, glass cover and backlit LCD display
  • Storage: 1 winding module 
  • Material: Plastic

products.title: Watch Winder Cabinet - Viceroy 16 Piece - Black
products.description_html:
The Viceroy 16 Piece Watch Winder Cabinet will keep 16 watches perfectly wound and protected, while the drawer accommodates additional watch storage for 4 watches, and a removable Triple Watch Roll for 3 watches with hidden capsule for those most precious things. 

Set your winders to their Turns per Day and rotation direction based on your watch requirements and open the cabinet door via the user-friendly WOLF Bluetooth app, giving you ultimate control.

Dimensions 
 63.5cm L x 21.5cm W x 92cm H

Features
  • Bluetooth app controlled: Apple & Android
  •  Rotation options: Customisable pre-programmed rotation 1–1,999 turns per day (TPD)
  • Settings: Clockwise, counter-clockwise, bi-directional
  • Start delay: Fully wound watches or those that have a power reserve, select from 1–255 hours, selected program will not start until start delay hours elapse
  • Lock-in dynamic cuff: Patented cuff & drum design ensures that cuff locks inside, ensuring watch is held safely in place
  • Size: Cuff and drum will suit all watch, strap & case sizes
  • Watch protection and winding: Keep 16 watches safe and wound, ready to wear. Use the WOLF app to set Turns Per Day and direction of rotation
  • Patented watch winders: WOLF winders count turns per day no other winder does this, others use time to estimate rotations.
  • Additional watch storage: Pull-out drawer houses 4 additional watches and Triple Watch Roll with hidden capsule inside
  • Locking tempered glass doors opened via Bluetooth app
  • Additional App controls: Start or stop all modules simultaneously, personalise cabinet name, upload picture of your watch as backdrop image, i-Mode feature that dims & turns off LED’s at night

products.title: The Den 4 Piece Safe - Black
products.description_html:
The Den safe has a vegan leather covered exterior and features four patented WOLF watch winders with storage space above including a Vault Tray with removable 3-piece watch tray. The door of The Den opens and locks with a biometric identifier or keycode. 

All four winders are preprogrammed to 900 Turns per Day, bi-directional with a 10 second start delay, featuring patented intermittent rotation programmes with pause and sleep phases. The Den can be anchored through 2 pre-drilled holes in the base and an additional 2 holes provided through the back of the safe. 

The Den gives you flexible, safe and secure storage for your watches and valuables.

Dimensions 
49.4cm L x 33cm W x 28cm H


Features

  • Patented Innovation - Every WOLF winder counts the precise Turns Per Day. All other winders estimate the number of rotations.
  • Lock-in Cuff: Patented lock-in cuff ‘locks’ your timepiece into the rotator drum for a secure fit. Low density foam to accommodate all wrist sizes without putting pressure on your bracelet.
  • Rotation: 10 second start delay, 900 TPD (Turns Per Day), patented rotation programs - Intermittent rotation with pause and sleep phases pre-programmed.
  • Directional Settings: Bi-directional.
  • Battery Option: Option to run the unit on AC power (universal adapter included) or AA batteries - alkaline or lithium (lithium batteries will last twice as long as alkaline batteries). Batteries not included.
  • Storage: 4 winding modules plus storage area including Vault tray with removable 3-piece watch tray.
  • Biometric identifier or keycode.
  • 2 predrilled holes in the base and back of The Den for anchoring unit.

Our patented technology of counting rotations of the axis of your watch guarantees precise Turns Per Day. Bold luxury and faultless design, take the Axis 8 Piece Watch Winder for a spin.

Dimensions
52cm L x 16cm W x 34cm H

Features 

  • Patented innovation: Every WOLF winder counts the precise number of rotations. All other winders estimate the number of rotations
  • Lock-in dynamic cuff: Patented lock-in dynamic cuff ‘locks’ your timepiece into the rotator drum for a secure fit. Low density foam to accommodate all wrist sizes without putting pressure on your bracelet.
  • Rotation options: 10 second start delay. Can be set between 300 and 1,200 TPD (turns per day). Double the amount of TPD by selecting bi-directional setting
  • Directional settings: Clockwise, counter clockwise and bi-directional
  • Power reserve setting: 6 to 72 hours in increments of 6 hours power reserve setting to accommodate watches with a power reserve, giving the watch time to release stored energy before the winding program begins. 
  • Battery option: Runs solely on AC power (universal adapter included).
  • Storage: 8 winding modules
  • Material: Vegan leather

products.title: Watch Safe - Atlas 4 Piece - Onyx
products.description_html:
The ultimate in security for your watches, jewelry & valuables. Forged in American steel, UL tested and certified for burglary & fire, the Atlas is an impenetrable fortress. Painted steel polished to a mirror finish, drawers lined with LusterLoc™ treated fabrics that stop tarnishing for 35 years. Watch winders are controlled by WOLF’s Bluetooth connected App. Control one or all winders at the same time.

Atlas. The world-class choice.

Dimensions 
55.9cm L x 61cm W x 101.6cm H


Features

  • Weight: 730 lbs / 331 kg
  • Bluetooth user-controlled app: Download app from Apple or Android store.
  • Rotation options: with the WOLF app you are effortlessly in control of setting the Turns per Day (TPD) for your timepieces(s) ranging from 1 – 1,999 turns per day (TPD)
  • Directional settings: Clockwise, anti-clockwise or bi-directional
  • Start delay: Users can program up to a 255-hour delay before the first winding cycle – accommodating for a recently worn timepiece or power reserve.
  • Lock-in cuff: Our patented cuff and drum design ensures that the cuff locks inside to ensure the watch is held safely
  • Size: Cuff and drum will suit all watch, strap and case sizes
  • Patented Innovation: Turns per day are guaranteed by our patented method of counting turns – no other company counts turns per day (TPD), they simply estimate the number of TPD.
  • Additional storage: 5 Black finished exterior, grey Lusterloc™ lined, pull-out drawers for watches, jewelry and accessory storage. 2 open drawers, 1 jewelry drawer, and 2 watch drawers.
  • Onyx or Titanium high gloss exterior and chrome trim with WOLF’s custom 1834 Gray LusterLoc™ treated ultrasuede interior.

products.title: Watch Safe - Atlas 20 Piece - Onyx
products.description_html:
The ultimate in security for your watches, jewelry & valuables. Forged in American steel, UL tested and certified for burglary & fire, the Atlas is an impenetrable fortress. Painted steel polished to a mirror finish, drawers lined with LusterLoc™ treated fabrics that stop tarnishing for 35 years. 55.9cm L x 61cm W x 101.6cm H

  • Onyx or Titanium high gloss exterior and chrome trim with WOLF’s custom 1834 Gray LusterLoc™ treated ultrasuede interior.

The warm and intense background of incense and patchouli is softened by the precious black vanilla and made fresh by the lively opening of cyst and chinotto: a complex and deeply rich fragrance, perfect to tell the thousand facets of a magic moment.

 Rattan sticks diffuser, incense, patchouli, black vanilla notes.

products.title: Transparent Turntable - Black
tags: Just launched in the online store
products.description_html:
Timeless Design

The Transparent Turntable is a reinvention of a classic vinyl record player, designed for a modern home and an ever evolving technology. The Transparent Turntable is meticulously crafted out of aluminium and tempered glass. It is a belt driven system with a built in phono stage, and a pre-mounted cartridge from Danish Ortofon.

Modular

Just like all Transparent products the TT has a completely modular design. With the future in mind, it is made for flexibility, upgradability and repairability.

Transparent Sound

The Transparent Turntable must be connected to a sound system to play music. It works excellent with a speaker from Transparent, but can also be used with other brands. It plays with effortless clarity and precision, and offers playback either with cable or without, using Bluetooth.
